articles.summary: Management to host conference call and webcast to discuss the results at 12:30 pm ET on that day LOS ANGELES, CA / ACCESS Newswire / November 11, 2026 / PodcastOne (Nasdaq: PODC ), a leading publisher and podcast sales network, announced today the planned earnings release date and conference call timing for its second quarter ("Q2 Fiscal 2027") of its fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 ("Fiscal 2027"). PodcastOne plans to announce its full operating and financial results for Q2 Fiscal 2027 and host an investor webcast to discuss the results and provide a business update on Thursday, November 12th, 2026 at 12:30 pm Eastern Time (9:30 am Pacific Time). articles.summary: NEW YORK, Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Galloway Capital Partners, LLC announced that Galloway Capital, LP and its affiliates, Schedule 13D filers in PodcastOne, Inc. (NASDAQ: PODC), strongly support the Company’s decision to form a Special Committee of the Board of Directors to retain a financial advisor to evaluate strategic alternatives to maximize shareholder value. Galloway believes PodcastOne’s public market valuation substantially understates the value of its content portfolio, advertising relationships and distribution capabilities, particularly to a strategic acquirer. The Company was recently ranked 6th among participating U.S. podcast publishers and networks measured by Podtrac, reaching approximately 5.8 million unique U.S. listeners. “PodcastOne has expanded its revenue, programming and audience, yet we believe those achievements remain inadequately reflected in its share price,” said Bruce Galloway, Chief Executive Officer of Galloway Capital Partners.
